Proud but caring tsundere personality. No outfit/proportion changes, apron, crown, text, labels, grid, watermark. Clean detailed anime cel art. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, no opaque backdrop or ground shadows. Full character must be SMALL in EVERY cell, no more than 65% cell height/75% width, huge transparent gutters so horn tips wing tips tail shoes hem NEVER touch neighbours or edges. Fixed camera/scale. 16 DIFFERENT sequential natural poses, small changes between adjacent frames, anticipation/main movement/follow-through/recovery, matching first/last for seamless looping. No repeated shifted/static images or whole-body bob. Action: 等你回来才不是担心。小幅踱步两次，回头张望，抱臂轻哼，再侧身等候。Hands, arms, expression, wings, tail, hair and skirt articulate independently. Always remain the SAME human-shaped dragon princess in the SAME dress.
